print("=" * 40)

print("=" * 40)
for key in ("accuracy", "precision", "recall", "f1"):
    print(f"{key:>10}: {metrics[key]:.3f}")
c = metrics["confusion"]
print(f"confusion: tp={c['tp']} fp={c['fp']} fn={c['fn']} tn={c['tn']}")
